text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... gh... Ha... 
wheeze...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What a pathetic state I'm in... Letting 
the win slip away, and totally wiped out 
on top of it...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Next time, it won't go like this...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
More... more, more! I'll show you I can 
become stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Why are your eyes glowing so brightly?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(How can ya be so sure we're gonna win 
next time?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even though my hands are completely full 
like this...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
..................I really can't beat 
that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to greet Lucky Lilac after her 
valiant effort in the Shuka Sho, but she 
was visibly exhausted both in body and 
mind...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I am deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I... never could... win this 
Shuka Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've watched Lucky Lilac's hard work and 
perseverance closer than anyone else. I 
believed in her victory more than anyone 
in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's so frustrating. That I 
couldn't lead her to victory today. That I 
made her apologize to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume who can endure and 
bloom. As her Trainer, I will keep 
believing in her and supporting her. I'm 
fully prepared to do so.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
From here on out once more... I look 
forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Was I... able to give a proper smile just 
now...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days after the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
S-So you're really running in the Japan 
Cup for your next race, then!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The victory I couldn't claim in the 
Shuka Sho— I will definitely seize it 
here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class members who have declared 
their entry are an exceptionally 
prestigious and formidable lineup. What 
are your thoughts on this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It was precisely with that feeling in 
mind that I decided to enter the race."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I will win the Japan Cup against an 
amazing field and prove that I am the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘This announcement from Almond Eye 
quickly spread among race fans, pushing 
anticipation for the Japan Cup to its 
absolute peak—’"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: What should we do about the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list:
I was thinking I wanted to race with 
Almond Eye

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The matchless rival I fought alongside all 
throughout the Triple Tiara. That is 
Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a rival like that running in the 
Japan Cup, Lucky Lilac must have mixed 
feelings about it. However—
choice_data_list:
If you want to run, it'll require some 
tough conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac was far more exhausted 
from the recent 'Shuka Sho' than we had 
imagined."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering a grueling race like the Japan 
Cup, where so many powerhouses gather, 
means risks are unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, what matters most is how Lucky 
Lilac feels."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she wishes to run, then as her Trainer, 
it's my duty to give my absolute all to 
make that wish come true.
choice_data_list: Could you share your thoughts with me?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I think I will pass on it. The Japan 
Cup, that is.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said, Trainer, I still have 
lingering fatigue from the Shuka Sho, and 
on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……I will have plenty of chances to run 
with Ai-san again in the future.
choice_data_list:
Okay, then let's pick a different goal 
race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As of right now, a prime candidate for our 
target race is the Nakayama Kinen—a 1800m 
turf GII held at Nakayama Racecourse next 
February.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a traditional race where Senior Class 
Umamusume often run to test their mettle 
with an eye on the big races from spring 
onwards.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The Nakayama Kinen, huh? ...Sounds good. 
By that time, everything should be fully 
back in top shape."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim for the Nakayama Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided to kick off the 
Senior Class with the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (This is no good...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(When I decided not to run in the Japan 
Cup today... Back then, I...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I felt relieved from the bottom of my 
heart... that I didn't have to race 
against Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is sooo lame~~~~............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It's stuck in my head... Reaching my 
limit at the Shuka Sho, that feeling—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: …………I can't picture it at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Seeing myself bloom—
